{{Infobox |eng = Fiddlehead Fern |source = [[Foraging]] |location = [[Secret Woods]] • [[Skull Cavern]] • [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Dangerous Mines]] • [[Ginger Island#Island East| Ginger Island Jungle]] • [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Tree (type 3)]] • [[Desert Festival]] |season = {{Season|Summer}}
{{Season|All}} on [[Ginger Island#Island East|Ginger Island Jungle]], [[Skull Cavern]] and [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Dangerous Mines]] |edibility = 10 |sellprice = 90 |xp = 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] |color = Green }} The '''Fiddlehead Fern''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] that can be found: *[[Foraging]] in the [[Secret Woods]] during [[Summer]] (78%). *Foraging in the [[Skull Cavern#Prehistoric Floors|Prehistoric floors]] of the [[Skull Cavern]]. *Foraging on levels 41-69 of [[the Mines]] while the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] is active. *Foraging in the [[Ginger Island#Island East|Ginger Island jungle]] in all [[seasons]]. *Occasionally at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|90}}. *By chopping [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Trees (type 3)]] during [[Weather|Green Rain]]. *By placing a [[Tapper]] on fully-grown [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Trees (type 3)]]. *In [[Kent]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. The Fiddlehead Fern is the only foraged item categorized as a vegetable. Being a vegetable, its sell price benefits from the [[Skills#Farming|Tiller]] 10% bonus and it can be turned into [[Jellies and Pickles|Pickles]] or [[Juice]] using a [[Preserves Jar]] or [[Keg]]. However, it also receives several [[Foraging]]-related benefits, because it is obtained by foraging. Specifically, 7 Foraging XP is granted per fern and it benefits from the [[Skills#Foraging|Gatherer]] double-harvest bonus and [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist]] iridium-quality bonus. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Leo,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus |dislike=Abigail,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Sam }} ==Bundles== *Fiddlehead Fern is used in the {{Bundle|chef||y}}. *Five Fiddlehead Ferns are one of the options for the {{Bundle|Wild Medicine||y}}. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|Header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Fiddlehead Risotto|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|Footer}} ==Tailoring== Fiddlehead Fern is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create {{Name|Shirt007|link=Tailoring{{!}}Green Overalls|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]]. ==Quests== Fiddlehead Fern is not used in any [[quests]]. ==History== {{History|1.4|Added to Prehistoric Levels in the [[Skull Cavern]]. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be found on [[Ginger Island]]. Is now an option in the Wild Medicine Bundle.}} {{History|1.6|Can now be obtained from [[Green Rain Trees|Green Rain Trees (type 3)]].
